shorts.title: Operation Northwoods: The Conspiracy That Was TRUE 🔍
shorts.description:
What if I told you US generals signed a plan to stage attacks and blame Cuba? One idea in the plan: fake the shoot-down of a civilian airliner with a remote-controlled drone. The memo was declassified in 1997.

#shorts #meatballinvestigates #weirdhistory #mystery #meatballmyths
